doc.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024

title: Thanks and goodbye
summary: Rowe thanks Davis, who mentions the transcription he must finish tonight.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well on that upbeat note, I want to thank you for your time. This was really informative and entertaining as well.

Oh Monk, thank you so much. Like I said, I’ve been a fan of the series and your work and when you sent me the email inviting me to do this I was super, super honored and happy to have the opportunity.
All right. Best of luck with that tough transcription you’re working on.
Thanks. I have a feeling I’m going to be up late tonight.
